snippet.title: Mirage Miracle Quest - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3838820/Mirage_Miracle_Quest
Join the Discord server community : https://discord.gg/jw7vPGccpg

Mirage: Miracle Quest is a modern take on the classic turn-based RPG, where strategy meets magical girl flair.
Join Mirage, a young exorcist, on a thrilling and mysterious journey to master her magical powers! Build unique skill decks, travel with a memorable team, and explore a lush, hand-painted world inspired by the spirit and wonder of Madagascar, France, and Japan!
